name: Ultimate Way Big
abilities: Cosmic rays fired as beams or projectiles from crossed arms
Cosmic energy saws (cut off one of Dagon's tentacles)
High-speed body spin that deflects energy beams
Immense strength (dragged the gargantuan Dagon to the ground)
Enhanced jumping; even larger than Way Big
weaknesses: Vulnerable to acid (Dagon's acid rain brought him down)
Enormous size - unusable in confined spaces
summary: The evolved To'kustar: a bigger, blue-and-white, horned Way Big that flies, spins away energy blasts and hurls cosmic rays and cosmic saws. Ben's last-resort weapon against Dagon.
traits: Last Ultimate form introduced in UA
notableFeats: Cut off one of Dagon's tentacles with a cosmic saw (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2)
Pulled the vastly larger Dagon down to the ground (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2)
Spun fast enough to repel Dagon's laser beams and withstood his energy attacks (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2)
Ultimately brought down by Dagon's acid rain (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2)

appearances.designNotes: Almost identical to UAF Way Big but recoloured: white body areas (except chest, hands, face) become blue, red areas (except shoulders/cheeks) become white, black becomes red; two curved horns on the sides of the head; larger than Way Big; evolved Ultimatrix symbol on chest.

image.label: UA
image.notes: Infobox image, but it is an episode screenshot (upper-body portrait, night sky background); the wiki has no official full-body render for this form. Other candidate screenshots: 'Ultimate Way Big 004.png' (cosmic ray), 'Ultimate way big flight.png'.

scoring.rationale: Planetary-tier physicals: dragged the colossal Dagon down, tanked his beams, deflected lasers by spinning, sliced a tentacle with a cosmic saw and fires cosmic rays at long range, all while flying. Only one outing, acid rain defeated him, and his size is a serious control problem anywhere but open ground.

notes: One-time form (The Ultimate Enemy: Part 2). Never used in AF/OV and never by Albedo.
No official model/render exists on the wiki - image confidence high only in the sense that it is the infobox choice; a human may prefer a different screenshot.
Not among the six sentient Ultimates in 'The Ultimate Sacrifice' (debuted afterwards).

Ultimate forms are artificial by-products of the Ultimatrix's evolutionary function (added by Albedo): the DNA is run through a simulated worst-case scenario over millions of theoretical years to force combat-oriented evolution. They are not natural Codon Stream species, and the Omniverse Omnitrix has no evolutionary function, so Ben never regains them after UA (Derrick J. Wyatt).
